items.issue: Advice to make a partner afraid to request exclusivity treats fear and leverage as substitutes for agreement.
items.disposition: Do not generalize or convert to action advice; require explicit, informed and revocable relationship agreements.

items.issue: The claim that accumulated investment makes a partner accept other partners relies on sunk-cost pressure rather than free consent.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize and unavailable for first-person guidance.

items.issue: The training comparison ranks and objectifies women as low- or high-quality practice targets.
items.disposition: Retain only the abstract deliberate-practice concept with a personhood boundary.

items.disposition: Weight 0 and use the formal parent source for context.
